operation: One offline descriptive forensic pass; no model imports/deserialization/execution, tests, bootstrap or new inference

selection.rule: The three preceding completed and accepted P1-history/P0-boundary calls in the retained ledger; no magnitude-based selection

joins: Explicit phase, sequence_id, history_program, boundary program where applicable, top-level token_index, reference flag, and explicit decision index. No action-index-derived token ID. Duplicate or missing records recorded, not guessed.
returned_prefix_summary: Only from a unique next-token or current-boundary incoming snapshot with exact recorded outgoing/incoming state-digest match; label as next observation, not a retained commit snapshot.

array_comparison.definition: Existing elementwise allclose: abs(left-right)<=atol+rtol*abs(right); shape exact; actual elementwise differences only

summary_comparison: Original math.isclose(atol=1e-6,rtol=1e-5), exact keys/shape/null topology; report signed l2 and max_abs summary differences only, never tensor distances
metadata_comparison: Exact; hashes are fingerprints, not retained arrays
first_difference_reporting: First retained differing observation, in defined semantic order: incoming summary/metadata -> preparation -> decisions (action before h_before/h_after) -> terminal -> returned observation/output. Not first causal error. Same-program final P0 boundaries analyzed separately from intentional prefix-program substitutions.
arithmetic_checks: Recorded labels/predictions/CE remain authoritative. Stable arithmetic recomputation from logged logits/probabilities is consistency corroboration only.
uncertainty: No bootstrap, intervals, new hypotheses tested or new population estimates. Partial ordered cases are not panel performance.
missing: Mark absent/non-readable data and association ambiguity; do not abandon available comparisons or infer equality from equal summaries
protected_inventory_policy: Hash each v4 evidence file read before/after; carry broader v4 findings as historical, without rehashing checkpoints or all617 protected identities
